- Registry page: https://hoiyu915-droid.github.io/open-scholarly-sources/sources/biorxiv.html
- Organization: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory
- Source type: preprint server / 預印本平台
- Subjects: life sciences / 生命科學, biology / 生物學
- OA scope: full / 完整 OA
- Peer-review scope: not peer reviewed / 非同儕審查
- Publication state: preprint / 預印本
- Access roles: discovery / 發現, metadata / 中繼資料, abstract / 摘要, fulltext / 全文, repository copy / 典藏副本
- Canonical URL: https://www.biorxiv.org/
- Verification evidence: https://www.biorxiv.org/about-biorxiv
- Checked: 2026-08-16
- English note: Life-science preprint server. Manuscripts are screened before posting but are not peer reviewed; versions and links to later journal publications are exposed.
- 繁中摘要: 生命科學核心預印本伺服器；刊登前會做基本篩查，但不是同儕審查，並保留版本與後續正式出版連結。
- OA model: repository / 典藏庫
- Effective from: not specified
- Verified open years: not year-specific
- Backfile: full / 完整回溯檔案
- Version scope: preprint / 預印本
- Licence scope: mixed / 授權混合
- Policy note: Frontier discovery source; screening is not peer review. API exposes version, licence, category and published-article linkage.

- Registry page: https://hoiyu915-droid.github.io/open-scholarly-sources/sources/open-library-of-humanities.html
- Organization: Open Library of Humanities / Birkbeck, University of London
- Source type: publisher platform / 出版平台
- Subjects: humanities / 人文學, literature / 文學, history / 歷史學, cultural studies / 文化研究, art history / 藝術史, archaeology / 考古學
- OA scope: full / 完整 OA
- Peer-review scope: peer reviewed / 同儕審查
- Publication state: published / 已出版
- Access roles: discovery / 發現, metadata / 中繼資料, abstract / 摘要, fulltext / 全文, canonical vor / 正式出版版本
- Canonical URL: https://www.openlibhums.org/
- Verification evidence: https://www.openlibhums.org/news/659/
- Checked: 2026-08-16
- English note: Academic-led diamond OA publisher and platform for peer-reviewed humanities journals, funded by an international library consortium rather than author fees.
- 繁中摘要: 由圖書館聯盟資助、作者與讀者皆不收費的學術主導 Diamond OA 人文出版平台。
- OA model: diamond / Diamond OA／作者與讀者皆不收費
- Effective from: not specified
- Verified open years: not year-specific
- Backfile: full / 完整回溯檔案
- Version scope: version of record / 正式出版版本
- Licence scope: mixed / 授權混合
- Policy note: No reader or author charges; journal licences and migrated backfiles should still be checked per title.
